changed.note: datetime.datetime.utcnow() -> datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) in generate_signed_token; value is used as the base for the 'exp' claim passed to jwt.encode

guesses.assumed: The 'exp' claim is consumed only by PyJWT jwt.encode, which converts datetime claims via utctimetuple(); this yields the same epoch value for an aware UTC datetime as for the previous naive UTC one, so no consumer line needed changes. No in-repo consumer compares this value.
